title: Nutritious Roasted Mexican Peach Pozole
description: A twist on traditional pozole, this recipe incorporates the sweetness of peaches and the richness of roasted vegetables. Perfect for a cozy dinner or lunch.
instructions: Place the chicken breasts in a sous-vide machine and cook at 130°F for 1 hour.
While the chicken is cooking, roast the peaches in a preheated oven at 400°F for 20 minutes, or until caramelized.
In a large pot, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic in a little bit of water until softened.
Add the diced onion mixture to the pot, along with the ground cumin and smoked paprika. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced hominy, low-sodium chicken broth, and peach juice to the pot. Stir to combine.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the sous-vide machine and shred it with two forks.
Add the shredded chicken to the pot and stir to combine.
Season with salt to taste, then serve hot in individual fondue pots.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, lime wedges, and diced peaches, if desired.
